text:
Anu: Heads-up — I'm drafting the Q3/Q4 roadmap for platform routing + multi-region tenant isolation. A few enterprise customers are pushing for per-tenant geo-fencing, hard isolation lanes, and per-tenant SLA guarantees. Need to decide scope, launch criteria, and sequencing. Thoughts?

Michael: +1. Productize isolation levels: soft logical isolation, dedicated slices, and full private stacks. Prioritize by SLA tier and compliance need. Launch criteria suggestions: perf baseline, migration path, audit logs, billing segmentation. Can we make these measurable SLOs?

Sarah: Observability is non-negotiable. We need per-tenant latency p95, cold-start rate, KV cache hit-rate, and traceable request IDs. Without that we can't safely roll out isolation.

Liz: @Anu heads-up from sales: FinCo, HealthCorp, and GovAgency are asking for this. FinCo needs geo-fencing + SOC2 evidence; HealthCorp wants an on-prem option. These are contract milestones — timeline matters.

Omar: Runtime constraints to call out: dedicated slices blow up GPU memory and reduce batching efficiency. Per-tenant KV caches will be expensive. Propose a shared cache with tenant partitioning + tenant-aware eviction heuristics. Also router fallback to compatible model variants when capacity constrained.

Kevin: I can build a cost model mapping slice size -> monthly infra cost -> recommended price tier. Also recommend a phased migration: start with per-tenant routing policies + soft isolation, then reserved slices for top N customers.

Anu: Can someone draft a minimal spec and launch checklist? My suggested MVP: 1) per-request tenant tagging; 2) router policies (region affinity, hard/soft failover, tenant quarantining); 3) per-tenant metrics surfaced in Console; 4) billing separation by tenant and slice. Proposed launch criteria: automated failover tests, SLA smoke tests, security review, legal/compliance sign-off.

DevOpsBot: Deployment plan stub created: https://ci.redwood/plan/1728501234. Proposed canary schedule: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 7 days. Alert thresholds: latency p95 > 250ms or error rate > 0.5% triggers rollback.

Sarah: Add an eval/regression harness tied to canonical prompt sets. If quality drops > 2% on those prompts, block rollout. Also include per-tenant golden prompts for sensitive customers.

Michael: Call out the batching vs latency tradeoff. Isolation reduces batch aggregation which hurts throughput and increases tail latency. We should expose batching config per-tier and quantify p50/p95/p99 impacts. Pre-warm KV on failover and have async cache refill.

Liz: Legal requires auditable data residency proof for geo-fencing. We'll need region-level mapping + immutable audit logs for customer data movement.

Anu: Action items: @Kevin run cost model and deliver options by EOD Fri; @Omar prototype tenant-partitioned cache in infra-sandbox; @Sarah wire eval harness into the rollout pipeline; @Liz gather customer legal/compliance specifics and contract triggers. I'll assemble a spec draft early next week.

Omar: One more flag — on-prem/private deployments will require changes to the control plane (private control plane option + deployment templates). Treat on-prem as a separate epic with its own timeline.

Kevin: I'll include migration timeline options (lift-and-shift vs staged cutover) and sample TCO for each.

Anu: Thanks all. Let's sync Monday 10am to review the spec draft. :thumbsup:
